cuaPermissions.approvalRiskNotice:
The agent can access only apps you approve, and can read and control them in the background.

Online games, messaging apps, and other apps may restrict automation. Violating their rules could result in your account with that app being suspended or banned.

Proceed at your own risk. To stop automated control at any time, press Stop in DeepSeek Harness.
